title: Mental Health Care Plans: Your Pathway to Support
excerpt: If you are struggling with your mental health, a GP Mental Health Care Plan may entitle you to Medicare-subsidised sessions with a psychologist or counsellor.
body: Mental health is just as important as physical health. If you're experiencing anxiety, depression, stress, or other mental health challenges, a Mental Health Care Plan (MHCP) prepared by your GP can provide a pathway to support. Under an MHCP, Medicare subsidises up to 20 sessions per calendar year with a registered psychologist, social worker, or occupational therapist. To access an MHCP, book a standard 30-minute appointment specifically for a mental health review with your GP at Morley General Practice. You don't need a referral — just call us or book online.
